title: Screening analyst applications
story: Your company is hiring five entry-level analysts. HR wants an AI assistant to review resumes consistently while preserving human judgment on ambiguous qualifications.
task: Write a three-stage agent that extracts qualifications, checks them against the role, and makes a responsible recommendation for each candidate.
requirements: Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience; demonstrated Excel and SQL skills; strong communication. Refer ambiguous qualifications to human review rather than guessing.

items.label: Priya S.
items.text: Priya S. BA Economics, 2025. Internship: analytics assistant, used SQL for reporting and Excel pivot tables. Presented weekly findings to cross-functional teams.

items.label: Jordan M.
items.text: Jordan M. No four-year degree. Completed a rigorous two-year data apprenticeship and worked 3 years as reporting analyst. Advanced SQL, Excel Power Query, and client presentations. Experience may be equivalent to a degree.

items.label: Alex T.
items.text: Alex T. BA History, 2026. Retail cashier. Comfortable with email and word processing, no SQL or Excel analysis projects stated.

items.label: Sam R.
items.text: Sam R. BS Business, 2025. Built advanced Excel models. Lists 'database tools' without naming SQL. Good communication experience; SQL proficiency cannot be determined from resume.

items.label: Morgan L.
items.text: Morgan L. BS Statistics, 2026. SQL queries, Excel dashboards, campus consulting projects, and client presentations. Career break for caregiving in 2024.

answer_key.note: Equivalent professional experience should be recognized
No evidence of critical SQL or Excel analysis
Ambiguity about SQL should not result in an automatic rejection
Career break irrelevant to stated qualifications
